# scm_dlp_peripheral (Data Source)

Retrieves details of an Enterprise DLP Peripheral.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a DLP peripheral by its ID.
data "scm_dlp_peripheral" "example" {
  id = "REPLACE_WITH_ID"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the peripheral.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the peripheral.
- `name` (String) The name of the peripheral.
- `printer_type` (String) Printer type (for printer peripherals).
- `product_id` (String) Product ID (for USB peripherals).
- `server_address` (String) Server address (for network share peripherals).
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
- `type` (String) Peripheral type: usb, printer, or network_share.
- `vendor_id` (String) Vendor ID (for USB peripherals).
